description: This file defines the implementation of a deterministic, backtracking-resistant pseudorandom number generator engine template class 'randen_engine' within the Abseil library, including its methods for seeding, generating, reseeding, and serialization.

classes.name: absl::random_internal::randen_engine
classes.description: A template class implementing a backtracking-resistant pseudorandom number generator engine with seeding, reseeding, and serialization capabilities.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns the next random value from the buffer, refilling it if necessary.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Initializes the engine with a seed value or seed sequence.

methods.name: reseed
methods.description: Inserts entropy into the engine's state from a seed sequence.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Advances the generator state by a specified number of steps.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two engine instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two engine instances.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Serializes the engine state to an output stream.

methods.name: operator>>
methods.description: Deserializes the engine state from an input stream.
